==Ingredients ==
*8 lbs [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
*2 ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cut into small pieces
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Cumin|Cumin]] to taste

==Procedure==
# Peel potatoes, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] into small or large wedges.
# Heat oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|pan]] to about 350°F. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] potatoes in oil until they are light brown. Once done, salt the potatoes to desired level.
# Fry the chicken for about 5 minutes. Drain the oil or move the chicken to a different pan.
# Salt the chicken, add ¾ cup of water and let [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 15–20 minutes.
# Combine chicken and potatoes (potatoes on top).
# Add cumin and let simmer for about 20 minutes.
